open_policies.policy: AAC phase recovery after invalid stereo parameters
open_policies.undecided: ISO/IEC 14496-26:2024 §7.18.1.2.1 specifies parameter decoding and leaves recovery from malformed PS payloads open.
open_policies.rule: Reset phase and disable the phase extension until valid data enables it.
open_policies.reference_rule: Reset phase values to zero and retain the last enable bit.

open_policies.policy: AAC envelope carry after a missing SBR payload
open_policies.undecided: ISO/IEC 14496-3 §4.6.18 defines SBR processing and leaves recovery from this missing payload open.
open_policies.rule: Use the full core band and reset the carry border.
open_policies.reference_rule: Preserve the preceding border and band limits with zero carried high band.

open_deviations.reading: The Annex D.8 perfect-reconstruction window applies when FILTS is one.
open_deviations.clause: ETSI TS 102 114 V1.6.1 Annex D.8 specifies the 512 coefficients of the perfect-reconstruction prototype.
open_deviations.candidate: The default decoder uses the Annex D.8 coefficients to produce PCM.
open_deviations.reference: The compatibility policy uses the recovered reference coefficients and produces different PCM of the same extent.
